title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit-logging hardening
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency at RBAC v2 layer and add audit logging for KMS key selection and residency violations. Feature gated and rollout controlled; no immediate customer-facing behavior change unless feature flag enabled. Backfill migration utilities included.
description: Motivation: tighten data residency controls and make KMS usage auditable. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 evaluation layer (policy-authorization path) and hardens audit logging to capture KMS key selection, region metadata, and policy-evaluation decisions. The change closes several gaps where service components could select a cross-region KMS key without a policy-level residency check, which risked accidental cross-region encryption for residency-sensitive tenants. What this PR does: 1) Adds RBAC v2 evaluator hooks to validate KMS key region against resource residency constraints and policy bindings (with deterministic deny on mismatch). 2) Adds detailed audit events for KMS key resolution (kms.key_resolved, kms.residency_mismatch, rbac.policy_evaluation) including actor, resource, requested_key_arn, resolved_key_arn, resolved_region, policy_id, and decision. 3) Introduces a migration to annotate existing policies with residency metadata where available and a compatibility layer that allows staged rollout via feature flag rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforcement. 4) Adds unit and e2e tests that simulate cross-region key attempts, service fallbacks, and migration idempotency. 5) Updates docs and admin console surfaces to show KMS residency violations in policy audit views. Rollout plan: gated behind feature flag and rollout to internal orgs first; monitoring added (metric: rbac.kms_residency.violation_count) and alerting on spikes. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged until flag is enabled; migration is non-destructive. See linked Linear tickets for context.
commits: feat(rbac): add kms residency check in rbac v2 evaluator
chore(migrations): add residency backfill utility for existing policies
feat(audit): emit kms.key_resolved and kms.residency_mismatch events
test(rbac): add unit tests for residency enforcement and policy edge cases
docs: update admin console and compliance docs for kms residency
fix(ci): add mock kms region responses for test harness
review_comments: Ethan Morales: Overall LGTM; please add a note in the migration about expected run time on large accounts and a safety timeout.
Priya Shah: Added migration timeout and progress logging to the backfill utility in the latest commit.
Sofia Kim: Can we avoid blocking critical request paths on a synchronous KMS region lookup? Suggest async primary path with fail-closed policy evaluation or local cache.
Priya Shah: Implemented a best-effort cache with TTL + fallback to deny when unresolved. Added config to tune cache TTL and to enable async resolution for service callers.
Jonas Becker: Two nits on naming and a suggestion to add an integration test for the console display. Also asked for a small perf run to check policy eval latency impact.
Priya Shah: Addressed naming nits and added console e2e test. Perf run (see CI) shows median policy eval increase ~1.8ms with cache enabled; within SLO.
merge_commit_message: security: enforce KMS region residency in RBAC v2 and add audit logging\n\nAdds residency checks, audit events, migration, tests, and docs. Feature-gated rollout.
post_merge_notes: Feature flag rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforcement created; migration scheduled during nightly window. Monitor rbac.kms_residency.violation_count and policy_evaluation.latency. Ops runbook updated.
notes_for_release: Enable feature flag in canary orgs only. No default behavior change. Customers with custom KMS setups should review residency annotations in policies after migration. Support contact: security-team@redwood.ai
